title: English Practice Quiz 0958
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A video conference allows people to ___.
options: meet and communicate remotely by video
questions.explanation: Video conferencing connects participants in different locations.

questions.question: In an email, the 'CC' field is commonly used to ___.
options: send a visible copy to additional recipients
questions.explanation: CC recipients are visible to other recipients.

questions.question: The 'BCC' field is used when you want to ___.
options: send a copy without revealing that recipient to other recipients
questions.explanation: BCC hides those recipients' addresses from other recipients.

questions.question: A file attachment is ___.
options: a file sent along with a message
a password typed in the subject
questions.explanation: An attachment is a file included with an email or message.

questions.question: A group chat should not be used to share ___.
options: sensitive personal information without a valid reason
questions.explanation: Sensitive information should be shared only through appropriate secure channels.

questions.question: A 'mute' button in an online meeting usually ___.
questions.explanation: Mute prevents your microphone audio from being transmitted.

questions.question: A reliable internet connection is important for a video call because it helps ___.
Before posting a work-related photo online, you should check ___.
options: the number of likes it might receive only
questions.explanation: Workplace images may contain private or restricted information.

questions.question: A hyperlink is text or an image that ___.
options: opens another page or resource when selected
questions.explanation: A hyperlink connects to another online location or resource.

questions.question: If a message contains an urgent request for money, verify it through ___.
questions.explanation: Independent verification helps detect impersonation and scams.
